verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments infrastructure platform with no AI-agent or assistant feature that could consume external MCP servers; the evidence only shows Finix publishing its own MCP server so external agents (e.g., Claude Code) can query Finix's API docs — that is the server role, not a client capability to plug in other tools. This story (acting as an MCP client) doesn't fit Finix's product category, so the axis is not applicable.
